programme.title: 荒野英雄 #5
programme.desc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #6
programme.desc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #7
programme.desc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #8
programme.desc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #9
programme.desc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #1
programme.desc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #3
programme.desc: 阿拉斯加已進入夏季。這為世上最大規模之一的阿拉斯加三文魚遷徙準備了舞台。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 阿拉斯加 #4
programme.desc: 座頭鯨回歸阿拉斯加豐饒的食堂,三文魚則回到河流產卵。不過,牠們必須跟飢餓的棕熊討一條生路。

programme.title: 蜥蜴的生存之道
programme.desc: 認識科學家們認為是生命及如何進化的故事的關鍵生物: 安樂蜥。

programme.title: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #1
programme.desc: 馬努費德的夢想是追隨儒勒凡爾納《80 天環遊世界》的腳步。因此,他為自己立下挑戰,要用他熱愛美食的眼界來環遊世界。他能成功嗎? 第一站—倫敦。

programme.title: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #2
programme.desc: 馬努在倫敦之後來到杜拜,很快就在當地累積了豐富的煮食經驗,因此他出發前往香料市場、魚市場和當地的甜品廚房。

programme.title: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #3
programme.desc: 馬努生平首次到訪印度,他想發現盡量多的食物。從蒸米漿糕的製作課程,到加爾各答花卉市場的鍛鍊。他能準時、完好無缺地到達香港嗎?

programme.title: 生死「莉」卜 #3
programme.desc: 一起尋找別具歷史性的鐵達尼號沉船事件中一位兩歲罹難者的身分。且看法醫測試、第一手陳述和新的基因證據最終如何有機會還不知名罹難者一個名字。

programme.title: 生死「莉」卜 #4
programme.desc: 調查90年代標誌性的新星布坦妮梅菲的死亡個案。察看專家透過目擊者的陳述、虛擬驗屍和化學分析來重現她英年早逝的個案,並瞭解過度的生活方式可能是導致她離世的原因。

programme.title: 生死「莉」卜 #5
programme.desc: 揭露世上最著名魔術師的離奇死亡之謎。察看專家重製胡迪尼的傳奇逃脫表演,以確定他的死是一場意外,還是一個想置他死地的強大團體所為。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #4
programme.desc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一。從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #5
programme.desc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #6
programme.desc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #7
programme.desc: 我們在本集將探索動物的溝通以及難以置信的適應能力,並揭示動物間能夠「交談」。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #8
programme.desc: 研究大自然動物中的交際花,揭示因同居而演化出的令人驚訝和難以置信的行為。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #9
programme.desc: 展示大自然一些最難以置信的動物頭腦,牠們的大腦顯現出高智慧,使牠們能在競爭中取得優勢。

programme.title: 打造不可能 #1
programme.desc: 獲伯沿著巴拿馬運河旅行,以瞭解無法被征服的地峽如何屈服於堅定的工程師的意志和技巧之下,從而創造出現今的七大奇蹟之一。

programme.title: 打造不可能 #2
programme.desc: 從洶湧的海到內陸莫哈維沙漠,獲伯發現一個講述偉大的科羅拉多州如何被馴服和胡佛水壩如何被建造的驚人故事。

programme.title: 打造不可能 #3
programme.desc: 獲伯前往蘇格蘭北部,發現英國石油工業的故事。儘管從第一批石油到今天創新的鑽探機,那是令人難以置信的工程。

programme.title: 空中戰士 11 #8
programme.desc: 這部紀錄片系列展示五代噴射機。這些戰機能夠攜帶炸彈並飛近太空邊緣。第六代戰機從2020年開始服役,第11季至今已經覆蓋了大部分此後的空中兵器。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #3
programme.desc: 馬努生平首次到訪印度,他想發現盡量多的食物。從蒸米漿糕的製作課程,到加爾各答花卉市場的鍛鍊。他能準時、完好無缺地到達香港嗎?

programme.title: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #4
programme.desc: 馬努前往香港,這是他環球之旅的第四個國度,當然亦安排了一些極品美食之旅。雞腳、添好運、掃街以及許多適合他去日本東京前的適應活動。

programme.title: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #5
programme.desc: 馬努的環球之旅已過一半,他前往探索繁華的東京。這是一個巨大的挑戰,因為在他正享受的同時,預算還有多少呢?

programme.title: 生死「莉」卜 #5
programme.desc: 揭露世上最著名魔術師的離奇死亡之謎。察看專家重製胡迪尼的傳奇逃脫表演,以確定他的死是一場意外,還是一個想置他死地的強大團體所為。

programme.title: 生死「莉」卜 #6
programme.desc: 揭露世上最厲害毒梟背後的死亡細節。查看新文件、錄像,以及跟艾斯哥巴兒子的採訪,揭示在子彈橫飛逃亡時,是誰給了他致命一槍。

programme.title: 山繆傑克森: 給我聽好
programme.desc: 憑藉無出其右的職業道德,山繆傑克森作為電影史上最傑出人物之一的地位毋容置疑。這位仍然擄獲全球粉絲的心的漫威演員,一起跟進他的傳奇。

programme.title: 小勞勃道尼: 爬上高峰
programme.desc: 當我們想到荷里活芸芸眾多藝人時……有一個名字脫穎而出。從他的辛酸到令人難以置信的果報……這就是小勞勃道尼

programme.title: 萊恩雷諾斯: 談笑風生
programme.desc: 《萊恩雷諾斯: 談笑風生》是一部紀錄片,追隨這位演員從溫哥華到荷里活的崛起,探索他的喜劇發展、個人生活、心理健康、慈善事業和社交媒體掌控力。

programme.title: 米高 J 福克斯: 演員樂觀活動家
programme.desc: 米高J霍士的一生,從成名到29歲被診斷出患上帕金遜症,就像一部真人秀電影,充滿了意想不到的轉折和顯著的韌性。

programme.title: 追夢女賽車手 #1
programme.desc: 業餘賽車手蕭詠詩 (Vivian Siu) 夢想征戰澳門格蘭披治大賽。她自費且經驗極少,迅速躍升至 F4,成為中國錦標賽首位女車手。她面臨著技術和籌集關鍵資金的巨大挑戰。

programme.title: 追夢女賽車手 #2

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #5
programme.desc: 小企鵝史拿帕在今集回到領地,但牠會被接納嗎?獸醫團隊準備治療蘇門答臘虎沙利,動物園則幫助拯救瀕危的本地物種。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #6
programme.desc: 有蹄類動物團隊在今集準備接生,我們遇到最長壽動物之一,奧克蘭動物園協助拯救瀕危的巨物。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #7
programme.desc: 長頸鹿嬰兒遇上族群,動物園的五個水獺兄弟正在移動,冷血動物團隊正尋找隱藏的寶藏。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #8
programme.desc: 動物園獸醫們在今集竭力拯救地球上最瀕危的鳥類之一,過程使他們十分焦慮;而冷血動物團隊正在野生的南島執行任務。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #9
programme.desc: 今集,動物園在沼澤森林歡迎兩隻鱷魚,新的東南亞棲息地開張,團隊準備為南方白犀牛寶寶慶生。

programme.title: 荒野英雄 #1
programme.desc: 奧克蘭動物園的靈長類小組準備迎接新生。

programme.title: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #5
programme.desc: 馬努的環球之旅已過一半,他前往探索繁華的東京。這是一個巨大的挑戰,因為在他正享受的同時,預算還有多少呢?

programme.title: 與馬努費德一起環遊世界 #6
programme.desc: 這是最後衝刺,馬努的名單只剩下一個國家。美國作為他冒險的最後一站提供了令人驚嘆的美食體驗。環遊世界。三十天。花費20,000美元。馬努能夢想成真嗎?

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #1
programme.desc: 廖崇明來到母親的家鄉北京,在中國這個古老國家開展烹飪、歷史和個人之旅。

programme.title: 美味走透透: 中國 #2
programme.desc: 崇明參觀了山巒起伏的美麗省份- 安徽,這是中國八大菜系之一的故鄉。徽菜是誠懇的農家菜,採用時令山野食材烹調而成。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 #3
programme.desc: 從巨型媒體帝國的女繼承人到被通緝的重犯,見證1974年的派蒂赫茲綁架奇案。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 #4
programme.desc: 以當時報導「山姆之子」的方式呈現事件,讓你沉浸在這謀殺案的戲劇中。

programme.title: 打造不可能 #1

programme.title: 進化中的素食者 #6

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Sulcata tortoises are the third largest land tortoise in the world, native to the Sahel Corridor in Africa They do not come from the desert!!! They need to take baths and drink water too!!!nThey are 5 to 7 centimeters tall at birth, with bright black eyes that are super attractive They grow really fast when healthy, adults can reach 09 meters in size and live over 100 years But they will easily catch a cold and get sick if you are not careful How to keep your turtles healthy? Let’s hear what the experts say!

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #102

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #3
programme.desc: 以打架聞名的強者全聚集在一年一班。無視於一旁慌張的榆井及冷靜旁觀的蘇枋隼飛,櫻與被他惹怒的杉下京太郎展開了一場豪邁的戰鬥。但防風鈴的總長梅宮一高分貝的聲音打斷了他們的攻防。當櫻等人神情緊張地仰望著擴音器時,等到的卻是梅宮出乎意料的一番話。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #4
programme.desc: 奉行力量至上的「獅子頭連」是個在鄰地稱王,以橘色刺繡外套為其特徵的集團。櫻為了保護鎮上高中生而與他們發生衝突,其副頭領十龜條因此對他宣戰。當他和柊登馬一起向梅宮報告時,不僅沒被責備,還受到感謝。就在此時,突然有道無邪但異樣的聲音響徹校園。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #1
programme.desc: 笨拙的狩龍人少年拉格納,與以壓倒性獵龍數聞名的天才少女蕾歐妮卡搭檔討伐龍族。但上級龍古流姆威迪,遠強過他們以往所討伐的龍,終結了這樣的日常。面對強敵,閃過拉格納腦海的是煩惱他多日的惡夢,獲取最強力量卻無值得守護的事物,充滿絕望與孤單的自己。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠的「弱者」林嘉明﹑台灣苦著名女藝人紀寶如及香港飽歷滄桑的媽媽Rain,因著上帝要活得更好!

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:愛是有『原』 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影專線:翻生奇兵

programme.desc: 前無去路,後有追兵,憑信心過紅海。n雲柱火柱日夜引路,天降嗎哪為持生命。n流浪曠野四十年,以色列人用血﹑淚﹑性命寫成的感人見證!n今天,對你有甚麼啟示呢?n李盛林牧師與你深入探討《出埃及記》中的主要資訊,讓信徒掌握此書卷之意義,並如何落實應用於現今世代。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠的「弱者」林嘉明﹑台灣苦著名女藝人紀寶如及香港飽歷滄桑的媽媽Rain,因著上帝要活得更好!

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:你的時間用在那裡? 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#10粵
programme.desc: 高將蕙婷書本弄污及弄壞溢滿的錄影機。翌日高慶發現宇生斷錯症大加指責，眾反指責他氣量淺，被妙喜趕出藥房。眾再設計要令高慶明白「含冤受屈」之苦，高慶力撐沒有看錯。高慶被孤立，拾一隻野龜飼養，視為「契仔」。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#21粵普
programme.desc: 令宜勸太夫人將十一娘送到鄉下別院，蓮房以為明淨也被藏在該處，想殺人滅口。誰知這是十一娘和令宜設的局，蓮房雖想狡辯，但被揭發一切都是她做的，她亦不得不承認…世顯得知十一娘已嫁給令宜，感到震驚及難以接受。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 主持們在順德特意前往品嚐新鮮豬雜粥，究竟有甚麼非吃不可的原因？冬季天氣寒冷乾燥，養顏湯水當然不少得。鼎爺出動珍貴海味炮製一道「杏汁白肺燉花膠」，並會詳細講解「啤水」等處理豬肺的步驟，讓食材風味能夠完全發揮。鼎爺與阿譚向來吃得夠豪、夠刁鑽，緊接示範的「XO醬爆炒龍蝦球」用上高級的澳洲龍蝦，煮出富貴級美味！期間鼎爺又以鹹魚取代金華火腿，示範製作改良版「家庭式」XO醬，當中的材料配搭如何體現其廚藝心思？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 心房顫動是常見的心律問題，成因與身體機能退化、長期病患等息息相關，除了影響心臟功能之外，更會增加中風的風險，不容輕視。腦神經科醫生詳析心房顫動的診治資訊，還針對服用薄血藥的疑慮作進一步解說。資深監製兼經理人陳善之入行逾四十年，與「天王」黎明合作無間，箇中留下甚麼深刻回憶？近年，他更涉足舞台劇擔任監製，並將粵劇元素融入其中，緣何會有這構思？「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐帶來「勁薑三蔥生爆雞」的教學示範。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 身體容易扭傷不容忽視，黃庭鋒、湯洛雯一組看穿片中主角存在骨質疏鬆的危機，相反何依婷與洪永城錯重點還死撐，還是聽內分泌及糖尿科專科醫生講解骨質疏鬆的成因及檢查方法。永城演繹一套鍛鍊動作，稱可減慢骨質流失，怎麼被醫生DQ？洛雯臨急偷改答案變「茅躉王」！患者不慎傷到哪個關節部位有機會增加死亡風險？兩組為此爭辯，永城一組始終未能突破零的局面？營養師帶來一款黑芝麻口味的高鈣甜品，始知洛雯對豆腐存在大大誤解。

programme.title: 陪著你走#3粵
programme.desc: 言重等候取藥時投入地看韓劇，發現胃痛消失。天從與導生到老人院探望記憶衰退的外公莊正，認為外公記得開心事已足夠。言重順利解決挖角事件，卻收到阮婉的辭職留言，胃痛又發作，醫生建議他要「慢活」……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 警察在學校用腹語術宣揚交通安全，小丸子見到後想起自己曾買腹語術人偶，於是約藤木同山田一起重操腹語術。小丸子見到其他人都有參與課外活動，自己也想效法，並在因緣際會下開始學吹陶笛。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 「零食廠」比拼正式展開，在「廠長話」的首個指令中，有小兵未能跟隨「廠長話」做動作。幸好「廠長」芭菲精靈給予機會，讓他得以繼續參賽……來到神奇地壺關卡，曲奇兵團的男隊員兩發兩中，成功「收集」到雪糕與啤梨。廠長隨即「加碼」要求香蕉，能否超額完成挑戰？某薯片小兵在「溶化之橋」運送雪糕，即將抵達終點前一度出現驚險場面，幸而成功「頂着」完成任務，當時情況怎樣？

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 龍龍帶大家去到「熱良院紀念館」，講述熱良院是如何誕生，又如何分裂成御富良院和御羅院。眾人回到外面世界，從Blockin口中得知炎上達在天守閣，但去到後卻發現等待他們的是御羅院、麥格和阿翔。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 皮膚出現水泡，感到痕癢、疼痛及紅腫，嚴重的話可能跟一種自身免疫病有關；小朋友成長需要充足營養，怎樣才算是均衡飲食？過胖標準如何量度？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 台慶頒獎禮舉行慶功宴，《新聞女王2》總監製鍾澍佳率領團隊盡情慶祝；「最佳女主持」車婉婉、「最佳男新人」劉洋分享獲獎感受；同場還有曾志偉、林敏驄開心相聚。事主與妻子結婚逾十年並育有四名子女，怎料驚悉兩名年幼子女並非其親生，奸夫更是身邊熟人。事主遂決定離婚，經訴訟後，法庭裁定雙方須出售舊居並分賬。但單位多年仍未售出，事主控訴前妻獨霸物業，反被指上門滋擾……此外，節目還會介紹結合藝術與健康生活的活動。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2717粵
programme.desc: Rebecca等人察覺樹仁對待栢菲甚差，栢菲卻為樹仁辯解，稱樹仁決不會以手段控制她。Rebecca建議栢菲可嘗試試探樹仁的真心。樹仁於點選外賣時，堅決不肯遷就栢菲，令栢菲決定測試他，結果卻令她失望。尚善協助栢菲審視她與樹仁的感情關係，提出問題檢驗樹仁是否重視栢菲，但樹仁的表現再次令栢菲失望。栢菲原本打算請假，思索與樹仁的關係，但在此時知悉樹仁受傷入院。她急往探望，發現自己竟錯怪了樹仁……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#16粵PG
programme.desc: 林蔚言受到警方的重點保護，周雄手下在別墅中央空調動了手腳，計畫通過氣體迷暈別墅中的一眾人員後，將林蔚言劫走。就在匪徒進入別墅打算將人帶走的時候，離開別墅的邵子俊帶人折返，配合在別墅周圍埋伏的警員，

programme.title: 宿敵契約#11粵普PG
programme.desc: 隨歌放戲陽與靜石逃離夙砂，一笑追他們之時不慎再次弄傷左臂，凌峰檢查後認為只有切開皮肉再修復經脈才能完全痊癒，隨歌為等待一笑完成治療而抗旨，平城忽然暈倒，眾太醫未能將他救醒，隨歌帶凌峰想醫治平城…

programme.title: 尋歡作樂的姐姐粵PG
programme.desc: 壓力太大想發洩？到畫室盡情潑墨吧，還有帥男細心調色與指導，他其後還準備好下午茶蛋糕，讓姐姐為蛋糕上色。依婷隨玲玲姐前往光顧隱世私房菜，型男主廚主打親手炮製的融合菜，同時會為每道菜配上合適的酒水，夠細心。一間「人氣」網美酒吧，先喝幾杯「打卡able」的雞尾酒，再有NPC男店員登場，施展力的表現，令姐姐們瘋狂大叫！有餐廳利用食材拼砌出中式名畫，睇得又食得，以蟹黃泡飯作結後，還有舞蹈員提供「特別服務」？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
名媛望族#16粵PG
programme.desc: 木水依指示毆打一洋人，往上海前卻被達志拘捕，指該洋人奇里夫死去。小由求啟燊救木水，啟燊及小由請指使木水的雷蟹作證，遭拒。Ali發現奇里夫與奇異特徵的洋人合照，相信對案情有幫助。木水庭上認罪，各人意外。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 台慶頒獎禮舉行慶功宴，《新聞女王2》總監製鍾澍佳率領團隊盡情慶祝；「最佳女主持」車婉婉、「最佳男新人」劉洋分享獲獎感受；同場還有曾志偉、林敏驄開心相聚。事主與妻子結婚逾十年並育有四名子女，怎料驚悉兩名年幼子女並非其親生，奸夫更是身邊熟人。事主遂決定離婚，經訴訟後，法庭裁定雙方須出售舊居並分賬。但單位多年仍未售出，事主控訴前妻獨霸物業，反被指上門滋擾……此外，節目還會介紹結合藝術與健康生活的活動。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 心房顫動是常見的心律問題，成因與身體機能退化、長期病患等息息相關，除了影響心臟功能之外，更會增加中風的風險，不容輕視。腦神經科醫生詳析心房顫動的診治資訊，還針對服用薄血藥的疑慮作進一步解說。資深監製兼經理人陳善之入行逾四十年，與「天王」黎明合作無間，箇中留下甚麼深刻回憶？近年，他更涉足舞台劇擔任監製，並將粵劇元素融入其中，緣何會有這構思？「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐帶來「勁薑三蔥生爆雞」的教學示範。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 身體容易扭傷不容忽視，黃庭鋒、湯洛雯一組看穿片中主角存在骨質疏鬆的危機，相反何依婷與洪永城錯重點還死撐，還是聽內分泌及糖尿科專科醫生講解骨質疏鬆的成因及檢查方法。永城演繹一套鍛鍊動作，稱可減慢骨質流失，怎麼被醫生DQ？洛雯臨急偷改答案變「茅躉王」！患者不慎傷到哪個關節部位有機會增加死亡風險？兩組為此爭辯，永城一組始終未能突破零的局面？營養師帶來一款黑芝麻口味的高鈣甜品，始知洛雯對豆腐存在大大誤解。

programme.title: 陪著你走#3粵
programme.desc: 言重等候取藥時投入地看韓劇，發現胃痛消失。天從與導生到老人院探望記憶衰退的外公莊正，認為外公記得開心事已足夠。言重順利解決挖角事件，卻收到阮婉的辭職留言，胃痛又發作，醫生建議他要「慢活」……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#10粵
programme.desc: 高將蕙婷書本弄污及弄壞溢滿的錄影機。翌日高慶發現宇生斷錯症大加指責，眾反指責他氣量淺，被妙喜趕出藥房。眾再設計要令高慶明白「含冤受屈」之苦，高慶力撐沒有看錯。高慶被孤立，拾一隻野龜飼養，視為「契仔」。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#21粵普
programme.desc: 令宜勸太夫人將十一娘送到鄉下別院，蓮房以為明淨也被藏在該處，想殺人滅口。誰知這是十一娘和令宜設的局，蓮房雖想狡辯，但被揭發一切都是她做的，她亦不得不承認…世顯得知十一娘已嫁給令宜，感到震驚及難以接受。

programme.title: 街坊廚神舌戰新台韓粵
programme.desc: 主持相約嘉賓陳展鵬掃食韓國地道小吃，接着品味熱爆當地的芝士三文治。主持比較韓、港兩地的韓式麵食，又大吃特色雪糕、芝士肋骨等港式「潮食」。「學廚PK賽」，二人學習炮製韓式飯卷，能否掌握捲飯糰的致勝技巧？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#11粵
programme.desc: 溢滿對時間觀念非常敏感，有義再遲大到，溢滿偷看鄰桌少女手錶，反被誤會是色狼。溢滿一反常態，完全不依時間行事。他遇孕婦「作動」，首次不理「準時」原則幫孕婦截車，令自己送件遲到，竟得到「遲到」的特別獎勵。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 林世顯告知十一娘其母遇害調查結果，種種證據都指向徐令宜。十一娘灌醉令宜打探真相，令宜口口聲聲說是他的錯，十一娘聽後失魂落魄。令宜誤會世顯與十一娘關係，還發現他乃區家人，兩人起衝突，十一娘不慎刺傷令宜。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 香港懷舊小食買少見少，但鼎爺這位「粵菜活字典」要把「炸油糍（炸蘿蔔餅）」重現觀眾眼前，當然並非難事。為了這道香脆滋味的炸油糍，主持們還發生口角，鼎爺更笑稱要換拍檔！不過鏡頭一轉，鼎爺又為「重味譚」炮製濃香惹味的「柱侯牛腩」，可見二人感情要好。烹調期間，鼎爺又分享其「老頭子」的嘴叼故事，到底燜至甚麼模樣的牛腩才是上品？另外，鼎爺還引領阿譚尋找順德百年滋味，順德人的「蝴蝶」究竟是哪款香脆小食？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 青光眼是一種視神經衰退疾病，嚴重可致盲，也因初期無病徵而稱為「視力小偷」。此症分有慢性與急性，定期檢查可及早發現患上慢性青光眼。治療方面，目標是降低眼壓至安全水平，留意眼科醫生細說常用的三個治療方案。「軟餐」是專為吞嚥困難人士設計的飲食方式，能減少「落錯格」風險。吞嚥困難者常遇甚麼問題？軟餐又可怎樣滿足他們的身心需要？營養師到來詳細解說。「睇餸食飯」，保哥以新會特產龍桔入饌，奉上「龍桔燜火腩」。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 進食速度太快，會否增加患糖尿病的風險？護理系畢業的陳曉華與組員何廣沛爆內訌，鄰組的護士助手何沛珈亦遭同組丁子朗、麥美恩嫌棄，兩位「燈神護士」自組，合力製造崩潰！聽醫生講解糖尿病的成因，再齊齊玩遊戲了解食物的升糖指數。哪些因素會增加糖尿病風險？沛珈的詳盡解說贏回一仗。糖尿病者可出現多種急性併發症，但患上哪種癌症的機會較低？廣沛一組交白卷都有分！中醫師帶來有降血糖功效的湯水，兩組隨即挑戰蒙着眼摸淮山。

programme.title: 陪著你走#4粵PG
programme.desc: 言重放假首天便感百無聊賴，梁嬌想言重與加勁和好，游說他買加勁特製的「片頭腩撈粗」；言重找到阮婉勸她放假，謂自己以前工作太緊張，連累身邊人。梁嬌忍不住問言重和加勁發生了甚麼事，三年來互不見面。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 佐佐木爺爺受傷，小丸子叫來爸爸幫忙，結果收到特級酒作為謝禮，為了喝到好酒，爸爸也變得勤快起來。小丸子因為不想在體育課上跑步，於是跳起祈雨舞，食髓知味的她居然為測驗要求爸爸戒酒。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 源於瑞典的軟式曲棍球，相比起冰上曲棍球，裝備需求較少，上手亦較易。「Kids’ Notes」請來軟式曲棍球港隊教練、青年運動員，講解相關比賽規則，並示範基本動作。軟式曲棍球在香港仍屬新興運動，面臨不少困難，除了缺乏資助、練習場地不足，健兒也要用上公餘時間投入訓練。其中兩位受訪嘉賓是由球員轉變為教練及管理者，過程中遇到甚麼挑戰？教練還會細談港隊於2026年的參賽計劃與發展軌道，團隊的優勢在哪？

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 雙方正式開戰，御富良院和御良院有感駕駛魔神難分勝負，於是走下地面埋身肉搏，卻依然不得要領。阿渡等人加上阿翔和麥格齊心合力，終於戰勝御良院，但後者卻被炎上達吸收，並以炎上丸的姿態降臨。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 屯門新盤最後一期交樓，不過露台門難以打開，摺疊式餐桌也損壞，如何解決？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2718粵
programme.desc: 瑞輝因與罪犯宋天機「撞樣」，吃盡苦頭，深感苦惱之際，收到一神秘字條，內容提到對方不想再受瑞輝連累。有人拍片抹黑瑞輝，一眾網民卻認為片中人是宋天機，唯獨有一位網民為天機辯護。瑞輝懷疑此人正是天機本人，遂設法追查其身分，結果有意想不到的發現，並證實字條出自天機之手。瑞輝欲將天機繩之於法，設法引他現身，卻不果。力蓮為協助瑞輝，決定要以非常手段引蛇出洞……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#17粵PG
programme.desc: 連續多日的海上搜索仍然沒有找到周雄屍體，何浩輝卻認為周雄沒有死，陳耀揚說這是何浩輝沒能親手抓到周雄的心理作祟，邵峰也勸解何浩輝要將精力放到金融核彈上來。何浩輝與邵子俊到棠哥家，與紅姐和三號車眾人聚餐。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#12粵普PG
programme.desc: 凌峰救治平城，馬公公提醒隨歌若有人對他發難，一笑是命門。一笑猜如嫣與無影有關，答應隨歌離開卻暗地抓走如嫣，與她打賭面具人會殺她，如嫣輸了仍沒背叛面具人。隨歌發現死士營要暗殺侯靖，一笑追蹤殺手到慕容府…

programme.title: 尋歡作樂的姐姐粵
programme.desc: 為追求迷人線條，姐姐團跟男教練做硬核健身，沛珈試推雪橇裝置卻鬧出笑話……鍛練後深入冷療艙，全身肌肉重新激活。配合健康飲食讓身體淨化，藉藝術品般的素食料理進補一番！「齋戒」後要沐浴，凱恩、沛珈換上漢服「穿越」宋代，體驗古風文化，歎洞穴湯泉充充電。及後，姐姐們DIY典雅香牌，再一嘗結合美食、現場表演的沉浸式餐飲體驗，從不同角度領略中華文化魅力。由韓國Oppa主理的韓式精緻美食，又是如何帶來滿滿幸福感？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
名媛望族#17粵PG
programme.desc: 木水於下周三行刑，啟燊卻無法開口告訴小由。小由見木水，木水答應會娶小由為妻。木水行刑前達志拿飯菜給他，暗示他慢慢吃；木水行刑日，啟燊跟蹤小由到碼頭，木水與小由上船時警察來到，木水以為啟燊通知警方。

programme.desc: 溢滿對時間觀念非常敏感，有義再遲大到，溢滿偷看鄰桌少女手錶，反被誤會是色狼。溢滿一反常態，完全不依時間行事。他遇孕婦「作動」，首次不理「準時」原則幫孕婦截車，令自己送件遲到，竟得到「遲到」的特別獎勵。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 林世顯告知十一娘其母遇害調查結果，種種證據都指向徐令宜。十一娘灌醉令宜打探真相，令宜口口聲聲說是他的錯，十一娘聽後失魂落魄。令宜誤會世顯與十一娘關係，還發現他乃區家人，兩人起衝突，十一娘不慎刺傷令宜。

programme.title: 娛樂大家粵PG
programme.desc: TVB潛力王實在多！黎芷珊曾被邀拍三級片？商天娥於兩周內極速拍畢一部劇集？兩人分享的均是真事，引來極大迴響，另一嘉賓胡諾言則好奇娥姐要NG幾多次……「狼人」戰場，德丞化身「神級太醫」，首晚便認清四位刺客！丁子朗這位想冒充劊子手的刺客王，演技似乎尚待磨練。嘉賓們有另類方法玩「Cheat Chat」，黃嘉樂明知「蝕底」都要中招，娥姐為教吳若希夫妻相處之道，明知會輸都要傾囊相授，但不忘趁機向六號設陷阱！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 苦瓜雖有苦澀味，但絕不影響同煮食材的味道，故被稱為君子瓜。鼎爺在順德府右市場選購優質苦瓜，並一應阿譚的為食要求，分別以蒸、煎兩種烹調方法，奉上雙重口感的「釀苦瓜」。苦瓜原條釀入餡料，更可保留甘香味道？釀豆卜是家庭常吃小菜，只要巧加心思，豆卜也可變成花！鼎爺帶阿譚到訪工場，試食新鮮滾熱辣的即炸豆卜；及後將蝦仁、豬肥肉等餡料釀入豆卜，即成香脆鬆軟的「百花豆卜」。阿譚還用部份蝦膠，做成香煎蝦餅。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 濕疹、脂溢性皮炎都是嬰幼兒常見的皮膚問題，家長如何分辨？冬季濕度顯著下降，也會抑制皮膚皮脂腺分泌，或導致濕疹病況加劇。兒科醫生詳析濕疹診治資訊，同時釋除大眾對使用類固醇藥物的疑慮。視障藝術家即使視力一再退化，仍堅持以作家為終身職業，且聽他分享克服重重困難的追夢故事。他同時致力宣揚觸感藝術，身體力行推動傷健共融，還會教大家如何欣賞觸感藝術作品。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨師傅炮製一道「韓式燜牛尾」。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 運動後立即進食不利減肥？林盛斌(Bob)與太太，關曜儁與何遠東兩組同樣認為視乎食物種類而定，惹來「抄襲」疑雲，看哪組能夠從醫生手上取分。兩組分別設計運動後便當，遠東、曜儁再分享減肥餐心得。傳聞「防彈咖啡」有助減肥，嘉賓試飲後找出兩樣關鍵材料。甚麼是「生酮飲食法」？醫生提醒當中的注意事項。為何厭食症患者背脊會出現生毛現象？Bob自揭曾試過極端減肥法。另外，中醫帶來減肥食療湯水，還考嘉賓的用秤技巧。

programme.title: 陪著你走#5粵
programme.desc: 言重摸衣袋時找到舊屋門匙，回舊居看到雪糕車，不禁想起他十三歲那年的舊事。天從和導生來到公園邊吃雪糕邊看韓劇，言重經過坐到天從身旁一同觀看。看完劇集後天從才發覺有人在旁，她向言重道明自己失明，只是靠聽。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 山田扮鬼臉逗得大家笑成一團，回家後更拿來火男面具助陣，小丸子家中沒面具，於是嘗試自行製作。小丸子嘗試把蜜瓜籽拿去種，小衫待種子發芽後討了部分蜜瓜苗回去種，並把小丸子視為親密好友。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」再次展開，收看節目的小朋友是否已準備好一同接受訓練？平衡力訓練的大部份動作需單腳站立進行，大家要收緊腹部核心肌群，努力維持身體穩定。其中一個挑戰更要把一樽水放在頭頂，並嘗試不讓水樽掉落。另會利用橡筋帶鍛練上肢肌力，動作包括二頭彎舉、三頭肌屈伸等，做法怎樣？這集還會播放AI生成動畫《三隻山羊》的下半部份。山羊大哥與二哥面對怪獸，最終能否順利過橋？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 考試將至，陽葵和美月正努力溫習。這天剛巧是偶像公主空間維護日，無法進行偶像公主活動。與此同時，艾姆們在偶像公主空間回想主人的往事。不論是陽葵出道，與Ruby=Lazuli對決，到遇上阿紡，都令艾姆相當回味。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 在九十年代，香港有罕見的四胞胎出生，這對新手父母頓時成為新聞人物。究竟照顧多胞胎有何挑戰，父母對這個「甜蜜的負擔」，又有何看法？新聞掏寶和大家重溫1990年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2719粵
programme.desc: 大四喜遭生產商欺騙，出售的應援物品質素低劣，引起粉絲不滿，只好設法安撫群情，期望平息事件。樹根收到來自「黑粉」的死亡恐嚇，幸而無恙。其餘成員縱未受滋擾，卻各自出埠暫避風頭。敢威安排虹豆沙湯遠保護樹根，沙湯遠成功化解「黑粉」的各種惡作劇。樹根對沙湯遠關懷備至，令樹仁心生妒意，決意使計對付沙湯遠。陰差陽錯下，沙湯遠反而發現「黑粉」行蹤，成功捉拿該人，其身分更出乎眾人意料……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#18粵PG
programme.desc: 無獨有偶，三號車巡邏時救下一位身中槍傷的外籍人士，兇手再次指向南亞裔。連續數件南亞裔針對白人金融高管的槍擊案件，疑似與金融狙擊案有關，何浩輝跟邵峰分析，認為過於巧合。此時又發生一起南亞人槍殺白人案件。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#13粵普PG
programme.desc: 慕容曜與一笑攤牌，他警告一笑如果她向隨歌說出真相，他安排在宮中的人就會對陛下動手，隨歌將會失去一切。一笑放走如嫣，勸她離開玉京城好好生活，怎料如嫣還是意圖自殺，一直暗中跟隨她的一笑及時出手相救…

programme.title: 尋歡作樂的姐姐粵
programme.desc: 凱恩與沛珈置身隱世居酒屋，獲帥哥老闆推介試吃橫隔膜、手掌心雞串燒，令她們也大膽起來！特別矜貴的燒提燈，口感有多「得意」？燒肉最怕麻煩，找爆肌店員幫你燒，還會以自身來說明該肉的部位，滿足姐姐的「欲望」。凱恩隨依婷到衝浪館學習基本動作，為的是可牽手「人氣」外籍教練穿著西裝一起室內衝浪，姐姐立即變得型格！玲玲率眾來到坐擁外灘景致的餐廳，享用專人拆肉的大閘蟹，以及考刀功的松鼠桂魚，不時不食，味蕾大滿足！

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 聖水洞之吻(完)
programme.desc: 【年下實習生朴所羅門戀年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟戀化學效應！！】業界能力頂級的行銷組組長姜娜恩，雖是個性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成績單。遇上公司內MZ世代又期待戀愛的實習生蘇恩浩，兩人上年下的相處，因年齡及價值觀不同互相嫌棄。卻因意外接吻捲入「靈魂交換」事件。之後兩人會發生什麼有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 奔跑吧薔薇
programme.desc: 【紈褲子弟情留落難千金，尋覓守護愛情的甜蜜配方】過著豐食無缺沒有大小姐架子的薔薇。一場家中巨變，面臨相親結婚丈夫的背叛，經濟困境及失去原生家庭的後盾。困境中憑著對料理的熱情及新生活，與食品公司會長的孫子相戀，奔向對方的路上還會遇上什麼樣的考驗?

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.desc: Misha is a very lively, alert cat. She is very interested in investigating everything going on around her, which means she has some very entertaining adventures with her friends. programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by "Drunken Master", this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: Wong Hsia Yuan is a traditional kung fu master whose academy is on the brink of closure. Chan Mei Ling arrives from U.S. to revitalize the academy but her way of recruiting students is going beyond questionably legal. Yuan is furious, but when the local triads enter the picture, Yuan and Ling join hands to take back the neighborhood.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperor's tomb.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot...

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted "Venoms" martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists' cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named "The Fastest Sword" but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chou's parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents' deaths.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: One of the great Kung-fu film characters is "Beggar Su", a legendary Ching Dynasty figure who was also a member of the famous Ten Kwangtung Tigers. Little-known director Liu Shih-yu uses the best Kung-fu actors Shaw Studios had to offer to tell a rare, colorful, action-packed adventure, as Beggar Su and his brother train incessantly to defeat the brutally powerful thief called Centipede.

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: West Chamber
programme.desc: The story is based on a famous Chinese opera. A young impoverished scholar, Zhang, is enchanted by Hong, the daughter of an influential family whom he meets in a temple. The young couple faces the threat of separation due to her family's objection, so Hong's maid secretly helps to arrange their rendezvous in the West Chamber!

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Bao's chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous "Twin Swords" in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaw's sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the "Jackie Chan style" is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a "drunken master" for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Loh's looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet "Classic Beauty".

programme.title: Police Force
programme.desc: A man joins the Hong Kong police force to track down a murderer who has killed his friend in a robbery. While he struggles to reconcile his law defending police duty with his desire for vengeance, he also has a new-found respect for the law.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiance, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Love For All Seasons
programme.desc: May, acting leader of the Er Mei sect, cures the incurable illness of Tiger, a rich playboy. Under the threat of her senior, May seeks help from Tiger to experience heartbreak and master the "Heartbroken Sword" style, so as to defeat her senior and preserve Er Mei sect. Will this strange and long-winding relationship reach a happy ending?

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father's underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau's economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: The Story of Woo Viet
programme.desc: Former Vietnamese veteran Woo Viet arrives a refugee camp in Hong Kong and meets his pen pal Quan. Subsequently, he encounters Shum Ching, with whom he attempts to flee to the US. However, the pair end up stranded in Manila's Chinatown, where at the hands of the local triads Woo becomes a hired killer, while Shum is forced into prostitution.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - Tea Time Trouble
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Gnome Your Enemy
programme.desc: Jim undertakes his first Trollhunting mission by starting small: he must shrink down to eight inches tall to apprehend a mischievous gnome.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Waka Chaka
programme.desc: When Jim and Toby investigate a Goblin attack, they discover Changelings are secretly living amongst them and rebuilding the Killahead Bridge!

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Win, Lose Or Draal
programme.desc: Everything comes into perspective when Jim discovers his re-match with Draal is to the death.

programme.title: The Croods Family Tree S1 - Guy Time
programme.desc: When Eep wants alone time with her new friend Dawn, Guy seeks a new friend of his own and finds an unlikely companion in Thunk.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - How to Start a Dragon Academy
programme.desc: Hiccup is given the responsibility to integrate dragons into the village of Berk and must contend with his rowdy friends, unruly dragons and an upset village elder.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S3 - A Little Adventure
programme.desc: The team encounters a small problem when they land on a planet called Faunus, where they try to recharge their lions using a native element

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S2 - Get Rich Quick Noogie Nights
programme.desc: Richie Rich visits Harvey Street to shut down a game gone rogue. Lessons learned at a murder mystery party help Richie make his first real friends.

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged S3 - Superchargers
programme.desc: When Ty and the gang sift through the destruction left by the Dreadtrux they discover that it changed the crater in surprising ways by unleashing a huge cache of supercharger bit bugs

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Stink of Fear: Chapter Two
programme.desc: While Boris and Natasha continue their mission and Bullwinkle tries to overcome his stage-fright to advance in the cooking competition, a secret government agency begins tracking Rocky & Bullwinkle's movement

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Who Wants To Live In Baa's Meadow?
programme.desc: Baa's feeling lonely as his buddy Billie the mouse has gone off for the day. Jess goes hunting for someone to come to the meadow to live with Baa. He find a fish to live in the trough, but there's no pond weed for him to live, he tries Sammy snail but he carries his own home on his back so he doesn't need a new home, finally they realise that there are ants already living with Baa in the meadow.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Why Are The Ants Visiting Mimi?
programme.desc: Mimi's painting a lovely picture at her hutch, with Jess along for a visit. Suddenly she's collapses in fits of tickly giggles, there are ants everywhere.. Mimi can't paint, tho, whilst she's being tickled and Jess works out they are here for her honey sandwiches!

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - Why Do Spiders Build Webs?
programme.desc: The friends are having a tidying up day. Frightened Baa doesn't like spiders or their webs but Jess helps him to stop being scared by working out that Spiders build webs to catch their supper, and Baa feels re-assured and happy. Spiders are rather nice, rather clean and rather clever.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We Bring The Outside Inside?
programme.desc: Poor Willow has a sore hoof and has to stay inside until it's better. She's really missing her orchard so Jess and Mimi are determined to bring something of the outside to Willow to cheer her up. A tree is too big and it's too late in the year for apples. Jess works out that they can make beautiful tree and leaf rubbings into a wonderful tree collage for the stable to remind Willow of her orchard.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - What's My Favourite Thing About Spring?
programme.desc: Mimi has promised Jess a special surprise if he can work out what he likes best about the Spring… He finds out that there's blossom on the trees, fresh new grass, bright young flowers in the Springtime. But he decides his very favorite thing is the newly hatched very cute little baby birds which his friend Little Bird has been singing about all along.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Hide Without Being Found?
programme.desc: Willow is the best hide-and-seek finder! Jess is determined to work out a way of hiding without Willow finding him! A trip to the pond where he discovers that both Horace and Sammy Snail are camouflaged leads him to work out that he too can do the same to hide from Willow at last!

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Accidental Hero Rich Kid Ra
programme.desc: Accidental Hero In order to win the Fright Stuff Award, Casper consults his uncles for scaring advice. Rich Kid Ra When Ra pulls up to Scare School in a solid gold chariot, everyone suddenly wants to be his best friend.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Dragon Quest Opposite Day
programme.desc: Dragon Quest The unlucky staff of a medieval-themed restaurant in Deedstown, get an unfriendly visit from Professor Thurdigree Burns. Opposite Day When Wolfie's experiment with moonlight goes awry, everyone but Casper turns into his or her opposite.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Heavy Metal
programme.desc: The Rescue Riders get stuck in a cave with their rival, Magnus, during a race to find a new source of an important mineral.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Iced Out
programme.desc: Frustrated that she's not fitting in with the team, Aggro goes off on her own with Elbone on a mission to save a dragon egg trapped in ice.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Boov Flu Blues Get Me To The Gorg
programme.desc: Oh comes down with the Boov Flu and Tip accidentally turns him into a flu monster Tip help out all his friends when they freeze into Boovsicles.Tip and Oh take off on a space road trip to see the Gorg Babies.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Kung Boov Werewolves Of Chicago
programme.desc: Tip teaches Oh her version of kung fu so he can stand up to a bullyOh finds a real wolf to teach him how to become a werewolf for Halloween.

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S1 - It's a Wonderful LARP My Sectional Romance
programme.desc: Audrey’s obsession with fun gets her too wrapped up in the Bloogey Boys’ LARPing game. The Harvey Girls and Bloogey Boys battle over who’s the rightful owner of a cool couch.

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S1 - Cereal Tiny Danger
programme.desc: The Harvey street kids set out to solve the mystery of who stole their one of a kind cereal! Lotta fights back when Tiny is told that he’s too small to race in a bike race.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Spinny Water Kelp's Song
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! Kelp saves them all using his unicorn spark to create bubbles he attaches to seaweed. Kelp helps his unicorn friends create music with their horns and pieces of nature. Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Playground Sparkless
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelp’s "fun-crastinating" puts the project in jeopardy. Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Pupcakes \ Stink or Swim
programme.desc: When Tag discovers that Scooch is a great baker, she encourages him to start a pupcake stand. But when Tag rounds up more customers than Scooch is prepared to handle, Scooch can’t keep up with the demand. \ Tag and Scooch’s race to pick up the most trash on Pawston Beach is thwarted by Frank and Beans, who just want to make more of a mess.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - A Ball-For-All
programme.desc: It's Ball-entine’s Day, the day when the dogs of Pawston show their affection for each other by exchanging balls. But unfortunately, the town is fresh out, so Tag and Scooch set sail for Ball Island. \ If Tag and Scooch want to leave Ball Island with the balls they chose for their family, they must earn them by proving themselves ball-worthy, through a series of challenges from The Fetcher.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - The Amazing Donna Bye, Bye Boardie
programme.desc: When Donna decides to show off her not-so-flashy skills as a magician at the Community Center talent show, the Zenkos must do everything they can to save her act from becoming an embarrassing disaster. After Sam’s favorite skateboard accidentally gets put in with donations Mr. Tanaka is collecting for a fundraiser, the team is led on a merry chase as the skateboard passes from one Harmony Harbor denizen to another.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Lula's Last Stand Triple Trouble
programme.desc: Little Lula has set up a lemonade stand, but she’s not getting any business. The Zenkos swing into action to send customers her way. When Donna, Fawna and Rona have a spat, the triplets’ longstanding annual tradition of viewing a comet together is in jeopardy. Now it’s up to Team Zenko to get the three feuding sisters back together again before the comet streaks by.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tree Troubles Missing Pieces
programme.desc: When Marcus brings home the class tree sapling for the weekend, the Dew Drops see it starting to wilt and must cheer the sapling up, so Marcus can make sure to plant it for his class. When Athena accidentally breaks Lola's nature sculpture, the Dew Drops must go on a scavenger hunt to replace the missing pieces.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Ticket Trail Flying Solo
programme.desc: Lola, Dylan and Cassie have tickets to the carnival, but when Dylan loses his ticket, the Dew Drops set out to find it. When Phoebe accidentally gets tossed into Nicholas' diaper bag before a trip to the park, Phoebe has to help a baby bird, while Eden and Athena must help Marcus rehearse for his big concert.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Caved And Confused

programme.desc: Tag wants to do something special for her Mom and Paw’s anniversary, so she recreates the boat cruise where her parents first met. \ Tag discovers that nothing is planned for Pawston’s 100th birthday, so she decides the town needs to rebuild the old Bonestand for a big Pawston concert.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Lost and Found In the Park In the Dark
programme.desc: The Community Center's Lost and Found is full and it's up to the gang to use their detective skills and return the lost items to their original owners. Rodney only needs one more bird on his birdwatching list, but the only problem is that it only comes out at night! Team Zenko must help Rodney face his fear of the dark so he can get the last picture for his collection.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Longest Yardwork The Girl Who Cried Goose
programme.desc: Donna plans a garden party for Rona, but the only problem is that her garden is overgrown and neglected. The team try to transform this jungle into a backyard just in time for the party. Lula finds an angry goose on the loose, and Team Zenko need to get it out of the park before soccer camp starts.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Yarn Fairy Bake It ‘Til You Make It
programme.desc: When the trees start losing their leaves, Phoebe begins knitting the trees in the park sweaters, but when the neighborhood kids see the sweaters they think they're a mysterious "Yarn Fairy," and they want to see her in action, making it much harder for the Dews to put more sweaters on the latest trees that have lost their leaves.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Things That Go Bump Hide Like a Dew Drop
programme.desc: When "something" starts snatching things and causing havoc in Marcus' house, Phoebe and the Dew Drops investigate only to find that it's a stray kitten that they need to catch and find a home for before Marcus returns home. But in the end, Marcus decides to take the kitty in, as his own. Lola isn't very good at "Hide &amp; Seek" so the Dew Drops help her improve her game. But she becomes so good that no one can find her! And now she’s going to be late to her own surprise tea party!

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Gran Day Out
programme.desc: When Gran moves into the cave with The Croods, she drives Grug nuts and embarrasses Eep in front of the first-ever group of cool kids.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Night Of The Living Croods Spoonful Of Soo-Gar
programme.desc: When The Croods experience the first-ever sugar-rush, they're hooked on the delicious new food; Grug is labeled a zombie after taking the first nap.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Mega Fat
programme.desc: After Mega Fat is fired from Baby Corp;he’s forced on the path of recovery towards being a Good Baby. However;Mega Fat is more interested in getting revenge on Boss Baby than finding the perfect family to adopt him.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Halloween
programme.desc: Boss Baby uses the cover of Halloween Night to sneak into Bubeezee’s Headquarters to shut it all down. Tim covers for Boss by distracting Marisol with a night of trick or treating.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - The Wings Of War Part 2
programme.desc: When Stoick decides to take the battle on the Dragon Flyers to the Edge, the Riders must figure out how to trap the Flyers and take back the Edge

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - No Dragon Left Behind
programme.desc: After being ambushed by aggressive Slitherwing dragons on a new island, the Riders think Stormfly has been poisoned and race to get an antidote

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Pirates
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a pirate treasure map in the shape of the dollhouse (a piece of it has been torn off). This must mean it’s time for a pirate treasure hunt in the dollhouse! Pirate Gabby and Pirate Pandy head out on their journey across the many "lands" of the dollhouse to find the Gabby Cats Treasure!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - MerCat Gets Her Sparkle Back
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes beakers filled with a magical potion, they conjure up an invite for Spa Day at the dollhouse! However, while decorating for MerCat's favorite day of the year, MerCat accidentally loses her color and sparkle. Gabby and Pandy must help her get her sparkle back for the big Spa Day party!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Troublesome Treachery of the Thieving Toot Fairy
programme.desc: George and Harold race against Mr. Krupp to try to get him fired before they get expelled

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Tenuous Takedown of the Tyrannical Teachertrons
programme.desc: In the season opener, George and Harold have returned to school due to a technicality, but the school has been taken over by Melvin and a cyborg Melvin from the future! Their goal is to make the school extremely difficult by replacing all the teachers with Teachertron robots. Suffering under the new regime and without Mr. KruppCaptain Underpants on hand to help, the boys hypnotize gym teacher Mr. Meaner and turn him into Sergeant Boxers to fight back.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Frantic Fury of the Fearsome Furculees
programme.desc: Tired of the Melvins ruling the school, the boys realize that they need Mr. Krupp to make the school at least bearable. Unfortunately, Krupp has run off to Ecuador to look for a fabled fountain. So the boys form the M.I.S.F.A.R.T.S. - Mega Incredible Search Force Adventure Rescue Team Squad - to travel to Ecuador and bring Krupp back, whether he wants it or not.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Poison Ravine
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Master Key
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Pyg & Tam
programme.desc: Boss Baby encounters a new threat to Baby Love: an adorable Baby TV show starring Pyg the Pygmy Goat, Tam the Tamandua, and their host Maria-Maria. Boss is told not to go to Corporate War by Board Baby Emiliano, so Boss tries to provoke his enemies to make the first move.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Conference Room B
programme.desc: Boss promises Tim he'll help make their parents' anniversary present, but after Puppy Co. and Baby Corp's fight over a conference room escalates, he sends Hendershot is his stead. Hendershot, armed with a file on all of Tim's wants and needs, tries to keep Tim happy.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in Business S2 - Game Plan
programme.desc: Boss tries to rename the local soccer team to "The Babies", but after Danny gets involved in the popularity race with his name, "The Hot Dogs", the town becomes divided. Boss creates a crack team of Baby Corp employees to game plan solutions to the worst outcomes.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - The S. S. Friend-ship
programme.desc: After the PALs encourage Maricela to make new friends, she forms the exclusive "Poshy Posse" with Priya, Sahir and Alex.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - The Gavel of Justice
programme.desc: Someone stole Bebe's gavel and used it to break a window at the academy! Everyone seems to suspect Alex ... but Pru is certain he's innocent.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free: Riding Academy S3 - The Rival Racer
programme.desc: A swift new recruit joins the school racing team, putting Lucky's dreams of riding out front in jeopardy. Pru and Abigail clash over a class project.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Unsolved Mystereep
programme.desc: When Gran's cane and Sandy's bear go missing in the middle of the night, Eep chases down every clue to the first-ever mystery to find the thief.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - Gran The Unfriendly Ghost Bad Sandy
programme.desc: Gran is sick of the Croods not listening to her advice and fakes her own death. But, when the Croods don't mourn to her liking, she haunts themAhhh! Valley threatens to exile Sandy after a string of bad behavior unless the Croods can get her under control

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S3 - In Plain Sight

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP37
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP6
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP22
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP3
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP1
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).

programme.title: 人間新聞
programme.desc: 人間衛視不同於其他電視台定位，一向致力於打造媒體新視野，並期許為新聞界注入一股清流。《人間新聞》此次改版，將再提升新聞品質與水準，落實公益電視台的媒體責任。《人間新聞》報導的焦點包含慈善公益、社會關懷、文化藝術、人文教育、心靈提升、健康醫療、環保議題等內容，藉由這些新聞與專題報導，將傳遞真善美的人間清流，提供觀眾更廣闊的新聞視野，與世界脈動接軌。

programme.title: 女士的品格(台)第40集
programme.desc: KPI至上的工作狂姚薇在事業上升期發現自己懷孕了。得知姚薇懷孕，公司挖角安暢來商務部做總監。安暢不僅有資歷、老公加持，還是頂客族，完美避開女性在職場的部分困境。糾結後，姚薇選擇生下孩子。就是這個決定讓一切發生了變化。

programme.title: 說人解字第15集
programme.desc: 以100多位歷史人物為主題，共說了近400則的成語故事，這些耳熟能詳的成語，出自數百年甚至是千年前，包括孔孟老莊、李白、杜甫、曹操、劉備……等上百位真實的、虛構的人物。以特有的說書方式，講述這些人的生平以及相關成語典故，輕鬆逗趣卻又寓意深遠。

programme.title: 生活智多星第1664集
programme.desc: 人間衛視【生活智多星】邀請到「好門媳婦」－郁方擔任主持人，透過輕鬆活潑的訪談，讓您成為生活上「智多星」。本節目邀請不同領域的專家學者，從科學的觀點，深入淺出地剖析生活大小事。打破您心中的疑慮與似是而非的偽知識，了解事情的源由與真相，提供不一樣的想法與見解。【生活智多星】內容豐富多元，例如針對銀髮族的需求，邀請銀髮族運動專家，將因久坐而氣滯血瘀的沙發馬鈴薯大變身，強力打造出活力四射、充滿元氣的不老傳說。以及有關吃的大哉問：吃進嘴裡的是營養還是毒藥，吃的順序、吃的方法與吃的健康，從不吃壞肚子到吃到強身健體，【生活智多星】全面關心。

programme.title: 閻小妹第47集
programme.desc: 這是一座介於鄉村與都市間的迷你化、可愛化的小城鎮-東閰鎮。裡面住著許多東方傳說中的人物、妖怪以及擬人化的動物。故事主人翁閰小妹是東閰鎮鎮長的獨生女，就讀東閰國小三年級，班上有各式各樣的妖怪同學，還有一位來自西方的留學生迪米歐。迪米歐和閰小妹兩人成為一對有趣的搭檔，產生出許多好玩的趣事。在東閰鎮裡，每天可以認識許多稀奇古怪的妖怪，每個角落都有著新奇有趣的故事等待被發掘。閰小妹將帶領著迪米歐與同學們在東閰城裡一起學習、一起探險，也將引導觀眾，重新認識華人文化裡，最具奇幻魅力的異想世界。
